The long history of the widget

By Sam Writer, March 3, 2026

Widgets have been part of daily life for more than a century, and the way they are made has changed with every generation of tools. Early widgets were cut by hand from sheet metal, one at a time, in small workshops that served a single town. Part 1 of this story follows how the trade grew, who made the widgets, and what they cost the people who bought them.

What to keep in mind

  • Keep widgets dry at all times
  • Store widgets away from heat
  • Check widgets once a year
  • Replace bent widgets at once
